text_block_list.text:
In today's race, I definitely grasped it! 
The potential to become the greatest 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And taking the results of this race to 
heart, I'm gonna take on both sprint and 
mile GⅠs next year! I've decided to be the 
absolute best at both distances!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the spring 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!! First, I'm gonna 
become the sprint champion!!
